name: Report to Thomas
summary: Guard Thomas is waiting at the eastern bridge for news of his missing men. He holds the crossing between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp with few guards to spare, and needs to know what happened along the river.

sections.title: A Grim Confirmation
sections.body: Guard Thomas holds the crossing between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp with few men to spare. When Malakai and Rolf vanished into the riverlands, he hoped they had only been cut off or delayed. Their recovered service medallions leave no such hope. Both guards were slain near the waterways.

sections.title: The Threat Along the Water
sections.body: For months, Stormwind's leaders have treated murlocs as nuisance river-dwellers, focusing instead on bandits and the kingdom's wider borders. Now two armed Stormwind guards have been slaughtered along the inland streams. The medallions show Thomas that Elwynn's eastern frontier faces an active assault, and he calls for a response before the logging routes and settlements are overwhelmed.

faq.answer: Guard Thomas is posted at the stone bridge over the river in eastern Elwynn Forest, on the road between Goldshire and the Eastvale Logging Camp.
Rolf and Malakai were Stormwind guards sent to patrol eastern Elwynn Forest. Murlocs along the riverbanks and Stonecairn Lake overwhelmed and killed them.
The medallions identify Stormwind city guards. Returning them gives Guard Thomas proof that his missing men died in the line of duty.

faq.q: Why is the murloc attack such a big deal?
faq.answer: Murlocs are commonly dismissed as primitive, cowardly pests. The deaths of two armed guards show that river tribes can carry out coordinated ambushes and threaten trained soldiers.

faq.q: What happens after reporting back to Thomas?
aliases: next quest after report to thomas
faq.answer: Thomas asks you to carry a report of the guards' deaths and the growing murloc threat to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire. Dughan warns that the region's defenses are already stretched thin.

faq.q: Why is Guard Thomas posted alone at the bridge?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is stretched thin across the realm, with King Varian Wrynn missing and resources strained. The eastern bridge and other outlying posts have few guards to protect vital routes.

angles.text: Rolf and Malakai's deaths show how exposed Elwynn Forest's borders are. Even routine river patrols can be overwhelmed when guards are scarce.
As a human, recovering the fallen guards' medallions gives Stormwind soldiers who died defending the kingdom's interior roads a measure of honor and finality.
